experience.description: Staff ML Engineer (Apr 2025–Present) | Senior ML Engineer (Apr 2023–Apr 2025) | ML Engineer (Mar 2021–Apr 2023) | Intern (Apr–Aug 2018, Sunnyvale, CA)
highlights: DRI for stereo matching company-wide: owned the full pipeline end-to-end (synthetic data generation → training → validation → optimization → deployment → V&V) and shipped production stereo depth for a da Vinci product, supporting FDA 510(k) clearance activities
Deployed two stereo models to production (high-accuracy and real-time variants) on edge GPU and Jetson hardware, using TensorRT quantization for live in-vivo inference on da Vinci
Designed a shared-backbone multi-task model (stereo, segmentation, classification, optical flow) that cut inference time 30% and reduced model footprint versus separate networks
Built the graph-based inference platform adopted by all ML teams at Intuitive, and an evaluation platform for regulatory-compliant V&V

Engineered the data engine for training and test sets: custom structured-light hardware for ground-truth depth, porcine and in-human experiments, endoscope/calibration limit characterization, and a reverse image search tool for surgical-video curation
Shipped real-time surgical-instrument segmentation and intraoperative anomaly detection on live endoscopic video
Built an autonomous CUDA optimization system using LLM agents that automatically optimized, compiled, profiled, benchmarked and validated kernels, improving production kernels by ≥20%
Led a team of 2 engineers and mentored 2 interns; drove close cross-site collaboration with R&D teams in Sunnyvale, CA and Germany

experience.company: AI in Medical Imaging Laboratory, ARTORG Center, University of Bern, Switzerland
highlights: Developed deep learning methods for surgical instrument recognition, pose estimation, and segmentation in minimally invasive surgery video
Built expert-level biomarker detection and segmentation models for retinal OCT, achieving clinical-grade performance in ophthalmology
Published 6 peer-reviewed papers (5 first-author, 1 co-first) in top-tier venues (MICCAI, Nature Scientific Reports, IJCARS); MICCAI Young Scientist Award (2019) and Prix Retina (2020)
Supervised by Prof. Dr. Raphael Sznitman, with collaborations from Prof. Dr. Sebastian Wolf (University of Bern) and Prof. Dr. Greg Hager (Johns Hopkins University)

Software, embedded, and electrical engineering across regulated/industrial settings: enterprise Java/Spring Boot backends and REST APIs (Comlab AG); embedded Linux and real-time data acquisition for seismic/structural monitoring (GSI GeoSolutions, GeoSIG); metrology-grade accelerometer calibration (Swiss Federal Office of Metrology)
